note: Rewritten from Chhotani (1997), entry 171; the original is in English. The alate is recorded as unknown in the original, and only the soldier and the worker are described. The synonym list, literature citations, figure numbers, type-measurement table and distribution records have been omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow, antennae, legs and body milky white, mandibles brown. Head pilosity sparse, body pilosity denser. Body length 3.8–4.8 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, the sides nearly straight, length to the tip of the frontal projection 1.35–1.37, length to the mandibular base 1.20, width 0.91–0.95 mm; the frontal projection acutely conical, clearly projecting beyond the mandibular base, its length 0.22 mm. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 4 slightly shorter than segment 2, the segments slender. Anterior margin of the labrum deeply concave, length 0.33, width 0.30 mm. Mandibles long and rod-like, the apex hooked, far longer than the head, length 1.43–1.45 mm, the ratio of left mandible length to head length 1.208. Postmentum rod-like, length 0.45, maximum width 0.30, waist width 0.25 mm. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, length 0.20, width 0.53 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow, antennae, legs and body nearly white. Head pilosity moderate, body pilosity denser. Body length 3.8 mm. Head subcircular, length to the labral apex 0.95–1.00, length to the mandibular base 0.65–0.70, maximum width 0.75–0.80 mm. Fontanelle plate pale, circular, translucent. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 shorter than segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus strongly convex, slightly more than half as long as wide, length 0.23, width 0.40 mm. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, length 0.18–0.20, width 0.45–0.49 mm.
